metadata.description: Independent Claude Code skills for everyday corporate work — each installable on its own. Charts and dashboards, meeting decisions, and more to come.

plugins.name: chart-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn any data — a table, CSV, pasted numbers, metrics, or notes — into a self-contained HTML dashboard, illustrated report, slide deck, printable one-pager, email-safe chart snapshot or Microsoft Teams post with interactive SVG charts. Picks the right chart type for your data automatically. No CDN, no build step, no runtime dependencies, works offline.

plugins.name: decisions-only
plugins.description: Pull only the decisions and commitments out of a meeting transcript, recap or notes — what was chosen, who owns what, by when — and nothing else. Not a summary: it discards everything that binds nobody. Paste in, answer out; no tenant, connector or admin approval needed.

plugins.name: whats-changed
plugins.description: Compare this period's numbers against last period's and say what moved, by how much, and which two or three lines explain the total. Reads workbooks, CSVs, PowerPoint decks, PDFs and Word docs — the pack as it actually arrives. Ranks the drivers, splits rate from volume, and refuses to invent a cause the source doesn't state.

plugins.name: sanity-check
plugins.description: Check one spreadsheet, deck or PDF for the mistakes that embarrass you in front of an audience — totals that don't cross-foot, error cells, shares over 100%, duplicated rows, stale dates, mixed units, a summary contradicting its own detail. Ranks what blocks sending from what merely invites a question. One artifact, not a period comparison.

plugins.name: exec-brief
plugins.description: Boil a long email thread, chat, status report or document down to one bottom-line sentence, at most three points and one ask — paste-ready for your manager or exec. Cuts everything that doesn't change what the reader does, and never firms up a date, figure or cause the source leaves open. Paste in, answer out; no connector or admin approval needed.

plugins.name: action-titles
plugins.description: Rewrite a deck's slide titles as the claim each slide proves — "Orders rose 17% in March to 5,480", not "Orders" — and flag every current title that claims more than its slide shows. Every number is on that slide; no cause, verdict or adjective the slide doesn't state. Reads .pptx or pasted slides; keeps the original title beside each suggestion; writes a retitled copy only when asked.

plugins.name: chart-honesty
plugins.description: Check every chart in a PowerPoint deck, or charts described in chat, for the ways a chart misleads: wrong chart type, a truncated or dual axis, 3D, pie misuse, a title the data contradicts, missing units. Gives the fix for each. Every finding cites a setting or value from the file, and a picture of a chart is never estimated from pixels. Reviews charts that already exist; it doesn't pick or build a chart, and it never edits the deck.
